label: Arclight: The Last Free Radio
summary: A pirate radio station is the last voice in Arclight that STEWARD does not control. Tonight STEWARD found it.
title: The Last Free Radio
description: Static Hour is a pirate radio show broadcast from a different rooftop every night, the last voice in Arclight that STEWARD does not write. You are its producer. Tonight, mid-broadcast, every drone in the district turns toward your rooftop.

chapterOutlines.title: Across the Rooftops
chapterOutlines.outline: Escape with the transmitter across a city that sees everything.

chapterOutlines.title: Back on Air
chapterOutlines.outline: Find a way to broadcast the truth to the whole city.

scene.location: A rooftop in the Glasswater district, during a live broadcast, in pouring rain
scene.summary: The host is mid-sentence. The transmitter hums under a tarp. Across the street, a hundred drone lights blink on at once.

openThreads: What truth is worth the risk of one more broadcast?

npcs.name: Lux Okoro
npcs.description: The voice of Static Hour: warm, funny and fearless on air, and terrified off it.

npcs.name: Rook
npcs.description: A wiry courier who runs the rooftops on spring-heeled boots and knows every gap between buildings.
goals: Prove he is part of the resistance, not just a delivery boy

items.name: Pocket transmitter
items.description: A brick-sized radio that can broadcast across three districts for ten minutes.

items.name: EMP charge
items.description: Knocks out drones and cameras in a small radius for a minute.
